font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<div style="font-size:0"><span style="font-size:14px">restored and visible</span></div>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
